suread: review R1 素读（只读 text/，未开 md）

facts.fact: 锁箱放到 Leon 梳妆台上
facts.anchor: I set the lockbox on his dresser.
Harrison wedged the crowbar in the space between the top and bottom.
I pulled out a stack of papers and began sifting through them.

facts.fact: 认定 Leon 在收集针对 Gazzie 与农场的证据
facts.anchor: Uncle Leon had been gathering evidence against Gazzie
“Dart, please listen.” Harrison’s voice cut through the silence.

facts.fact: Harrison 指认 Gazzie 杀了 Leon
facts.anchor: “That’s not how it happened. She did it. She killed him.”

facts.fact: 她把威士忌杯砸到墙上
facts.anchor: I hurled it at the wall.

facts.fact: Harrison 交代：父亲目击、收封口费、临终派他卧底
facts.anchor: Asked me to get a summer job at the farm to spy on her.

facts.fact: 承认暗中破坏农场（毁财物、刀上传信）
facts.anchor: tried sending a message with the knives

facts.fact: 她宣布结束并起身离开
facts.anchor: I stood from the bed, though every atom in my body protested.

facts.fact: Harrison 让她去问 Ginny、警告 Gazzie 危险
facts.anchor: “Ask Ginny,” he said from behind me.
Uncle Leon’s papers still clutched to my chest.

facts.fact: Gazzie 背后喝问、她没有回头走进雨里
facts.anchor: I left my grandmother behind, striding off the porch into darkness.

relations: Harrison 父↔Gazzie：目击后收封口费
she offered him money to stay quiet, he said yes.
叙述者↔Gazzie：怕她、相信她能伤人
I did believe Gazzie could hurt someone.
Harrison↔Gazzie：六年前借沙滩球混入家庭、长期破坏
six summers ago you knocked her over with a beach ball
Leon↔Gazzie：Leon 收集证据；儿时常逃到 Harrison 家
Leon used to run away to my father’s house
叙述者↔Aunt Virginia：曾提出救她脱离 Gazzie
her offer to rescue me from Gazzie was enough
numbers: 两本同样账簿（金额不同）
